lineStatuses.reason: WEAVER LINE: Saturday 26 September, all day, and Sunday 27 September, from 1015, no service between Hackney Downs and Cheshunt / Enfield Town. The limited number of GREATER ANGLIA and STANSTED EXPRESS trains which usually stop at Seven Sisters will stop at Tottenham Hale instead. Use London Underground connections between Central London and Seven Sisters, and for Rectory Road and Stoke Newington, use Clapton station. If travelling to the Big Bang concert at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, please use Victoria line trains to/from Seven Sisters or Tottenham Hale.
